thesis: A specific enthusiast reaction that credits the closed edit-run-push-verify loop and the visible tool-call cards, rather than generic launch praise.
finalText: closing the loop from the phone — edit, run, push, then check the remote commit — is the part most "code on your phone" apps skip. the diff cards and recorded check outcomes are what make this feel real. good luck with it

media.reason: The source post already carries the visual context; a reply needs no added media.

followValue: Shows a recognizable builder reaction: interest in whether a workflow actually closes end to end, not in feature lists. Adds a small signal of taste and judgment without turning a launch reply into a lecture.
relationshipValue: Gives the creator a specific, non-generic acknowledgment of the hard part of their build, which is more likely to be noticed than launch praise.
